Definition: from G4314 and G2980; to talk to, i.e. converse with:--speak to (with).
BiblicalUsage: Proslaleo means to speak to, to talk with. When the congregation was broken up, many followed Paul and Barnabas, who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God. In Rome, Paul called the chief of the Jews together and spoke to them of the hope of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Paul's speaking was always persuading toward continuance: he did not just win hearers, he talked them into staying in the grace of God.
